source.title: p-DCIM: A 28nm Probabilistic SRAM DCIM based Ising Machine for Near-Memory Context Selection in LLM-RAG Pipeline

workload.task: select a bounded, requirement-aware subset of retrieved passages for downstream RAG answer generation
inputs_to_freeze: candidate passage IDs and source snapshot
QUBO coefficient matrix including slack/penalty encoding

constraints: selected passages obey the same context token budget
selection is valid under the frozen objective/feasibility contract
downstream generation uses the same model, prompt, decoding and token limits for every solver
held-out query groups are disjoint from tuning/optimizer selection data
acceptance.rule: freeze absolute thresholds or non-inferiority margins before evaluation; do not borrow the source paper's scores as UQPU acceptance thresholds
acceptance.accepted_task_definition: one downstream answer satisfying all frozen task, feasibility and quality predicates

brute_force_exact_small.use: small instances only; publish objective/feasibility certificate
brute_force_exact_small.claim_boundary: no extrapolation from exact small instances to large instances

gpu_classical.use: competitive GPU QUBO or context-selection baseline

p_dcim_silicon.use: only instances actually executed on the fabricated macro

p_dcim_behavioral_model.use: larger source-paper workloads evaluated using measurement-parameterized behavioral model

qaoa_simulator.use: same QUBO and accepted-answer contract before hardware escalation

real_qpu_or_dwave.use: optional later comparison after simulation and acceptance gates

source_reported_metrics_not_uqpu_results.selection_energy_boundary: macro-normalized estimate derived from measured macro power, not complete system energy
source_reported_metrics_not_uqpu_results.hbm_hbf_package_integration: proposed, not fabricated in this work

required_resource_accounting: QUBO construction, coefficient quantization and programming
solver runtime, objective value, optimality gap and feasibility
input/output/state bytes, QUBO storage and transfer bytes
shots, billable units, retries and mitigation where applicable
output reconstruction and downstream answer generation
cooling and infrastructure allocation where material
total cost and energy per accepted useful answer
stop_conditions: exact small-instance reference disagrees with solver objective/feasibility
held-out answer quality misses the frozen acceptance margin
data leakage or mismatched QUBO/input hashes is detected
full-stack cost/energy removes the apparent benefit
source-model outputs cannot be distinguished from direct-silicon measurements
non_claims: no UQPU reproduction of the source paper
no quantum advantage or QPU result
no general GPU/CPU/NPU or RAM/VRAM/HBM/storage replacement
no Pangola material substitution, accepted bio-oil, net fusion electricity or financing-rate result
